forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.intro: Passwords are reset by the platform admin. Contact them and they will give you a temporary password. You then choose a new one the next time you log in.
forgot.noContact: Ask your tournament organizer to contact the platform admin for you.
forgot.noEmail: No email is sent. For your safety the admin may check that the account is yours before resetting it.
